Name: Vibrant Pastoral Bear Family
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
Do you use VPR? Do you use Bear Family? Do you want the Bear Family to match VPR? I got you covered.

This recolors the house tilesheet, Caritas, the Rival Hearts house, a stepping stone, and the spouse areas. Versions for green fall and redrawn roof snow are also included!

This is a content patcher mod, so you don't have to worry about the file being overwritten with updates.

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url].
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR Redrawn[/url].
4. Install this mod.

[b]THANKS:
[/b]MadDogOfBlank for Bear Family!
grapeponta, Semisu, poohnhi for VPR and Redrawn!

Downloads.Description: Added VPR versions of Caritas, the spouse area, the stepping stone, and the rival hearts house. Added i18n support and snow roof setting.
